integrity.result: A self-contained all-parameter theorem and its proof, without reliance on empirical extrapolation.
integrity.unproved_limits: No broader all-rooted-tree closed form or publication-priority uniqueness is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The formula is for ideals of a one-minimum rooted-spider poset with disjoint chain arms, not arbitrary rooted trees or general finite posets.
The finite verifier covers 183 small isomorphism-types, while the infinite-family theorem is proved by recurrence and induction.
The historical literature review is targeted and cannot establish absolute priority; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: A dyadic one-bit law for online learning of order ideals on rooted spiders
